newsitem.title: USA: Precision Response sees lower Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Precision Response sees lower Q2 results.

text.p: Precision Response Corp said on Thursday it expects to report results for the second quarter ended June 30 significantly below current market expectations.
The company said in a press release it expects revenues of between $35 - $37 million and earnings of between $0.02 and $0.04 a share for the quarter.

The company said its revised second quarter expectations reflect the deferral of revenue into the third quarter for a pending Call Center Application software sale previously expected to close in the second quarter.

The lower results also include charges to account for unused capacity associated with a delayed AT&T Corp contract and for certain revenue recognition for systems development for key clients as an incentive to accelerate the filling of unused capacity.

The company said it anticipates reporting full-year revenues of between $170 and $180 million and earnings per share of between $0.45 and $0.55. Based on reported 1996 revenues of $97.6 million and earnings per share of $0.36, these expected ranges would imply year-over-year growth of between 74 - 84 percent in revenues and 25 - 53 percent in earnings per share, the company said.
Precision Response provides telephone-based customer service and marketing solutions on an outsourced basis to large corporations.
